title: NovaFlow AI Platform Overview
content: NovaFlow AI is an autonomous enterprise revenue and workflow automation platform built for high-velocity B2B sales teams. It combines sub-second conversational AI voice agents, intelligent lead qualification (BANT/MEDDIC), real-time sentiment tracking, and bidirectional CRM synchronization. Teams deploy NovaFlow AI to answer inbound inquiries in under 500 milliseconds, qualify prospects across 5+ languages (English, Spanish, Hindi, French, German), handle technical and pricing objections using grounded company knowledge, and automatically book qualified discovery calls directly onto Account Executive calendars.

title: Pricing Tiers & Licensing
content: NovaFlow AI offers three transparent subscription tiers with a 20% discount for annual billing. 1) Starter Plan at $499/month: includes 1,500 AI voice minutes, 2 concurrent channels, standard HubSpot/Pipedrive sync, and email support. 2) Growth Plan at $1,499/month: includes 6,000 AI voice minutes, 15 concurrent channels, bi-directional Salesforce & HubSpot integration, custom RAG knowledge base (up to 500 documents), multilingual voice packs, and real-time analytics. 3) Enterprise Plan starting at $3,500/month: includes 25,000+ voice minutes, unlimited concurrent burst channels, custom LLM/VPC deployment, SOC 2 Type II BAA/DPA, dedicated Solutions Architect, and 99.95% uptime SLA. No setup fees for Growth and Starter; 14-day pilot available for qualified teams.

title: Enterprise Security, Privacy & AI Guardrails
content: NovaFlow AI is SOC 2 Type II certified and fully GDPR and CCPA compliant, with HIPAA-ready BAA options on Enterprise plans. All voice streams and transcripts are encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256. Automated real-time PII redaction masks credit card numbers, SSNs, and sensitive tokens before storage or LLM logging. Zero Data Retention (ZDR) agreements ensure prospect call data is never used to train foundation models. To prevent AI hallucinations, all product claims and pricing figures are strictly grounded via Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) with source citations and confidence thresholds.

title: CRM, Calendar & Telephony Integrations
content: NovaFlow AI integrates natively with Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, and Pipedrive in under 15 minutes using OAuth 2.0. Every call automatically creates or updates Lead/Contact records, logs full transcripts, attaches BANT qualification scores, updates opportunity pipeline stages, and fires signed HMAC-SHA256 webhooks to custom endpoints. Calendar scheduling connects to Google Calendar, Microsoft 365 Outlook, and Calendly with real-time slot conflict checks, timezone normalization, and automatic .ics calendar invite delivery. Telephony supports WebRTC browser voice, Twilio Elastic SIP Trunking, and Vonage.

title: Customer Case Studies & Measured ROI
content: Across 140+ B2B deployments, customers achieve an average 4.2x ROI within 90 days. FinScale Cloud (120-person SaaS) reduced inbound lead response time from 4.5 hours to 11 seconds, increasing qualified demo bookings by 38% and saving $18,000/month in manual SDR triage. MediOps Global deployed multilingual English/Spanish/Hindi voice qualification and expanded APAC & LATAM pipeline conversion by 44% without adding headcount. Average cost per qualified meeting drops by 63% compared to traditional outbound SDR operations.

title: Onboarding Timeline & Support SLA
content: Standard Growth onboarding takes 5 to 10 business days, while Starter teams go live in under 48 hours. Day 1-2: Connect CRM and upload product PDFs/FAQs to the RAG vector index. Day 3-5: Configure qualification rubric (BANT/MEDDIC), brand voice persona, and calendar routing rules. Day 6-10: Shadow-mode testing, live call QA, and production launch. Enterprise deployments include a dedicated Solutions Architect, 24/7 priority Slack channel, and a contractual 99.95% uptime SLA.

title: Objection Playbook: Budget & Pricing Concerns
content: When prospects express concern about pricing ($499-$1,499/mo), reframe against the fully loaded cost of a single human SDR ($6,500-$8,500/month) and missed after-hours inbound leads. A Growth plan at $1,499/mo handles up to 6,000 minutes (roughly 1,200 full qualification calls) at $1.25 per call, operating 24/7 in 5 languages. Even converting 2 additional deals per quarter typically covers the entire annual subscription. Offer a 14-day pilot or Starter tier ($499/mo) to validate ROI before scaling.

title: Objection Playbook: Already Using HubSpot/Salesforce or Human Team
content: NovaFlow AI does not replace your CRM or human Account Executives — it supercharges them. Unlike static website chatbots that prospects abandon, NovaFlow engages leads in natural real-time voice, qualifies BANT criteria in 2-3 minutes, and writes clean structured data directly into your existing Salesforce or HubSpot instance. Your human AEs spend 100% of their time closing pre-qualified, high-intent demos instead of chasing cold form fills or doing repetitive data entry.
